thread:
sam (Support): Heads up — AcmeHealth asked for finer-grained billing in the Console. They want per-route + per-user token breakdowns, plus clickable trace links to the raw request for any high-cost spike. They said it's blocking a purchase decision.

mira (PM): Thanks. Do we have the exact ask list from their CS ticket? Can you paste it?

sam (Support): Copied from ticket:
> Need: daily per-route token & $ cost, user-level rollup (SAML user id), latency p95/p99 by model variant, and a trace link from the cost line that opens the original request logs. Critical for procurement.

ashley (Sales): Confirmed — they signed up for Dedicated if we can show this in the Console within 6 weeks. They expect RBAC-safe access.

jordan (Eng): Quick feasibility Qs: where should the trace link point? We have request traces in prod-traces (zipkin-style) and raw request logs in S3. Linking to zipkin span id is straightforward, linking to a combined view needs a small UI.

mira (PM): MVP proposal: 1) Per-route/day token + cost table (group by customer route), 2) Clickable trace id that opens existing trace UI (no new UI), 3) Latency percentiles by model variant (24h/7d). No per-user UI initially — provide CSV export that includes user id.

chris (SRE): We can surface trace://{span_id} links that redirect to traces.redwood.internal/span/{span_id}. Need to ensure we don't expose internal traces to customer-facing Console; for Dedicated/Private we can gate by tenancy. For Hosted, we must scrub PII and only allow links for authorized accounts.

jordan (Eng): Implementation sketch: telemetry pipeline adds route_id + model_variant + user_id to billing aggregator. New frontend widget reuses existing cost table component. Backend: join billing events with trace metadata via request_id. Rough estimate: 3 wks infra + 2 wks frontend (small team).

mira (PM): Launch criteria draft: - Unit tests + e2e for cost/trace join, - RBAC check for trace link, - Perf: query latency < 500ms for 24h window, - CSV export includes user_id and route.

ashley (Sales): Buyer will accept CSV-only for per-user if UI time is tight, but they prefer direct UI. Sounds like a likely close if within 6w.

sam (Support): Note: customer asked to surface cost by model variant (so they can see cheaper quantized models).

jordan (Eng): Add to scope: model_variant column. T-shirt size: M. Risk: joining high-cardinality user_id will spike aggregation cost; consider pre-aggregations or async export.

mira (PM): Prioritization — block on: legal signoff for trace exposure, and ops cost approval for pre-aggregation storage. If blockers cleared, target 6-week sprint.

chris (SRE): Action item for SRE: write a short runbook for redaction rules and RBAC checks on trace links.

mira (PM): Action items: 1) Sam create a concise intake ticket with the customer wording and attach contract note (sam), 2) Jordan spike telemetry join and estimate infra cost (jordan), 3) Chris prepare redaction & RBAC runbook (chris), 4) Ashley confirm deal timeline and accept CSV fallback (ashley).

sam (Support): Filed intake: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/IN-9876 — pasted ticket in the thread.

natalie-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up with customer in 10 days.

mira (PM): I'll add to the next prioritization board. If anyone has alternate scope ideas to shrink timeframe (e.g., CSV-first + trace links later), say now.

jordan (Eng): CSV-first + trace link to internal support UI = fastest path. I can start spike tomorrow.

mira (PM): OK locking that as Plan A. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
